glossary.definition: (A) "Fresh fruits or vegetables" means all fresh fruits or fresh vegetables.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.51 to 925.60 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.51 - Prepackaging at retail store level definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Container" means any package with capacity, not to exceed five pounds, either entirely transparent, or so constructed that at least two-thirds of the contents are visible.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.51 to 925.60 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.51 - Prepackaging at retail store level definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Person" includes any individual, company, partnership, corporation, or association or any combination of individuals of whatever form and character, and any employee, agent, or officer thereof.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.51 to 925.60 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.51 - Prepackaging at retail store level definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Advertisement" includes all representations disseminated in any manner or by any means, other than by a label on the commodity, for the purpose of inducing, or which are likely to induce, directly or indirectly, the purchase of fresh fruits or vegetables.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.51 to 925.60 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.51 - Prepackaging at retail store level definitions.
